name: stylekit
title_zh: 给前端套上指定设计美学的样式包，默认丑样一键换皮
tagline_zh: 受够千篇一律的 AI 默认界面？Glassmorphism、Neo-Brutalist。
tagline_en: Tired of generic AI-generated UI? Get 10+ named aesthetics—Glassmorphism, Neo-Brutalist, Bauhaus—each with design.
desc_en: Apply a specific, consistent visual style to frontend UI you are generating. Use when building or styling web UI (pages, components, dashboards, landing pages) and you want a named aesthetic — Glassmorphism, Neo-Brutalist, Cyberpunk, Bauhaus, Apple, Stripe, Linear, and many more — instead of generic AI defaults. StyleKit gives you design tokens, component recipes, and AI rules for each style, with
why_zh: 不是调色板，是整套设计系统：令牌、组件配方、AI 规则三位一体，让风格贯穿每个按钮和间距，而非表面换色。
why_en: Not a palette—a full design system: tokens, component recipes, and AI rules work together, so the style permeates every button.
limit_zh: 只作用于生成前端代码时的样式输出，不改造已有项目；需要你明确指定风格名，否则退回默认；不含图片、图标等资源文件。
limit_en: Only styles frontend code you generate; won't retrofit existing projects. Requires you to name a style or it falls back to defaults. No image/icon.
title_en: Apply a named design style to your frontend UI, not AI.
